title: Questions, information needed, and answers — what must be resolved before a decision can reasonably be made
policy: Each row states the decision at stake, what we already know (verified in this repo or from an official source this session), what we do NOT know (answer left blank by policy), and a concrete discovery action that would produce the missing information. No answer is invented; blank means undecided.

rows.decision: Which existing workspace (of 22+) is canonical for NFL market data going forward?
rows.known: At least six peer namespaces maintain overlapping price-snapshot stores (nfl-book 39 rows, nfl-markets 12,573 rows, nfl-core, nfl-marketboard, nfl-price-snapshot, nfl-ledger); D-1/SUG-M3 already queue the question
rows.discover: Owner picks one store; others become read-only archives. Number that resolves it: n=1 recorded choice

rows.decision: Depth-order route: (a) per-club official depth chart pages, or (b) snap-count derivation (REQ-51)?
rows.known: Route (b) source verified to exist officially (Next Gen Stats participation, day-after; game-center snap counts); route (a) blocked for Texans (image) per brief, unverified here
rows.discover: 32-club verification pass: n=32 club checks, record pass/fail per route; choose the route with n=32/32

rows.decision: Price-data policy: accept third-party archived lines (labelled), find a licensed source, or stay blank?
rows.known: NFL publishes no odds (verified across sessions); archived third-party lines exist in-repo (nfl-arena, nfl-markets); -110 staking is an assumption (FB-02)
rows.discover: Options + trade-offs on the suggestions page (SUG-R3); owner selects one; record in data/price_policy.json

rows.decision: Does the repo-approximation of the private data layer satisfy REQ-39, or must raw row data move to private storage?
rows.known: Repo is public; raw captures are not rendered on the public pages but are public in git
rows.discover: Owner decision; number: n=1 recorded choice in this register

rows.decision: Snapshot cadence: Wed/Thu/Fri (REQ-53) or Wed-to-kickoff daily (REQ-54)? The brief asks both.
rows.known: Workflow currently runs Wed/Thu/Fri 18:00 UTC; Wed-Sat adds ~1/3 more runs
rows.discover: Owner picks; number: n=1 cron expression recorded

rows.decision: Is the '136-game log' (nfl-book n_train_games=136) the intended backtest corpus for REQ-19, or a different log?
rows.known: nfl-book own_lines_open.json contains n_train_games=136 (2026 walk-forward training log); no other 136-row log exists in the repo
rows.discover: Owner confirms identity; number: n=1 confirmation

rows.decision: Are the VR-xx / VQ-xx citations in the brief (e.g. VR-08, VR-24, VQ-05) resolvable artifacts we should import?
rows.known: No file in this repo defines VR-xx or VQ-xx IDs; they appear only inside the brief's requirement bodies
rows.discover: Owner supplies the tracker export or confirms the IDs are external; number: n=1 answer

rows.decision: When does the first strategy promote to LIVE under the existing gates?
rows.known: All peer strategies are PAPER; gates G1-G8/MG-1..8 require n>=100 settled bets / n>=80 forecasts with skill CIs; 2026 holdout results were negative
